differential.name: Atherosclerotic coronary artery disease
differential.rationale: Multiple risk factors (HTN, T2DM, dyslipidemia, obesity) and markedly elevated LDL/low HDL.

differential.name: Diabetic nephropathy (early chronic kidney disease)
differential.rationale: Hypertension and diabetes with mildly elevated creatinine despite normal GFR, suggesting early renal impairment.

differential.name: Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
differential.rationale: Metabolic syndrome, obesity, hypertriglyceridemia and dyslipidemia predispose to hepatic steatosis.

differential.name: Obstructive sleep apnea
differential.rationale: Obesity, hypertension, chronic neck pain and daytime stress are common in OSA and can worsen metabolic control.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Normocytic anemia in the setting of chronic inflammation (gingivitis, chronic pain) and multiple comorbidities.
